notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.8.2
notes.content:
This patch includes a Techtree update with better rewards.
 A gamebreaking bug when reaching higher waves was adressed. If you still encounter this bug please let us now.

notes.title: Controller friendliness
notes.content:
Heres how to use a controller with Zombocalypse:

Use the steam input for controllers and choose the community layout from us.
Make sure you enable "auto aim" and "auto fire" in the Options menu
You can now use the right stick as a mouse for UI selection and the left stick for movement. Change your weapons with the d-pad
Customize the layout for your needs

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.7
notes.content: FIXED Techtree Token Bug has been fixed and techtree now works as expected.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.6
notes.content:
FIXED Steamworks API integration threw an error preventing the player from playing multiple rounds


Known bugs:
Techtree tokens dont add up in techtree. Expect fix in a few days

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Game now pauses when you press escape in Singleplayer
 Morph Boss was falling out of View - fixed
 Fixed some bugs concerning the tech tree.

notes.title: Zombocalypse is now available!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Zombocalypse! Now that the game is live, I’d like to share a quick look at what’s coming next.

Our Plans for the Future:


 Launch & Server Stability – In the first week, we’ll closely monitor game and server performance to ensure a smooth multiplayer experience.
 New Features & Improvements – By the end of the month, expect exciting updates, including new bosses and refinements to existing mechanics. Your feedback is always welcome!


For now, enjoy the game—solo or with friends! Stay tuned for our next announcement.
